liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Weight** (1 review): Audience members cried during the performance, which the reviewer considers one of the best they have heard [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-09-15.141165.OTS.AKG.Ackerman.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 172 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1990-09-15.dsbd-patched.sirmick.77205.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 166 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1990-09-15.mtx.hansokolow.97498.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [8]
- **gd1990-09-15.161622.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 174 min [10]
- **gd90-09-15.sbd.barbella.7770.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 165 min; rated 3.9/5 by 21 [18]. Said about its sound: The recording sounds energetic after the space jam and features a rare post-Brent Gimme Some Lovin; The sound is described as strong from the first notes of Touch of Grey [22][26]

## Around the show

- Bruce Hornsby played grand piano during Playin' in the Band and belted out The Weight [22]
- The performance lacked the soulfulness of Brent's B-3 organ, which the reviewer noted was missing [28]
- Audience members expected Bruce Hornsby to sit in, a combination that left everyone smiling [29]
- Bruce Hornsby kept up with the band's improvisation during Bird Song on his first night [30]
- Bruce Hornsby joined the band for this show, which featured the final Gimme Some Lovin [1]
- The Dirty Gondola verse in Masterpiece was also played on the September 7 Richfield show [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-09-15.141165.OTS.AKG.Ackerman.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Ron Ackerman; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Master Audience Recording & Transfer by Ray Ackerman: AKG 460B/CK63 ULS -> AKG B18 phantom power unit -> Panasonic SV250 -> DAT (OTS); Transfer… [1]
- **gd1990-09-15.dsbd-patched.sirmick.77205.sbeok.flac16**: taped by thanks to Ben Dover for this source; transferred by SirMick; source: dsbd > dat > dat > dat@44k [3]. Also: Dave Brotman recorded with Schoeps mics; the source is a dsbd patched with dat transfers [3]
- **gd1990-09-15.mtx.hansokolow.97498.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of SBD: shnid=89070 and DAUD: shnid=9047 by hansokolow using ProTools [8]. Also: Dave Brotman recorded with Schoeps mics; Charlie Miller transferred two SBD cassette masters [8]
- **gd1990-09-15.161622.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 22, 2022; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [10]
- **gd90-09-15.sbd.barbella.7770.sbeok.shnf**: source: Analog SBD>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [18]
